title: Multi-Marginal Inverse Optimal Transport for Contrastive Learning Via Explicit Anchor-Positive-Negative Coupling
abstract: arXiv:2609.33741v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Inverse Optimal Transport (OT) based methods for representation learning learn representations such that the global OT coupling between a pair of data marginals in the representation space, concentrates on the positive pairs. This is in contrast to previous methods that primarily focused on pairwise matching. However, these methods $\textit{DO NOT}$ utilize negative pairs and hence are not truly contrastive in their approach. translated_title: 基于显式锚点-正样本-负样本耦合的多边际逆向最优传输对比学习
translated_abstract: 基于逆向最优传输（OT）的表示学习方法，通过学习表示使得表示空间中一对数据边缘分布之间的全局OT耦合集中在正样本对上，这与以往主要关注成对匹配的方法形成对比。然而，这些方法并未利用负样本对，因此其方式并非真正意义上的对比学习。我们证明这会导致维度坍塌问题，进而降低下游任务性能。为缓解这一问题，我们开发了一种新颖的多边际（MM）逆向最优传输（IOT）对比学习（CL）方法，称为Neg-MMIOT-CL，该方法学习表示，使得三个数据边缘分布之间的全局多边际最优传输（MMOT）耦合——相对于表示空间中数据点三元组之间精心设计的基础代价函数——集中在锚点-正样本-负样本三元组上。
tldr: 该论文提出Neg-MMIOT-CL方法，通过显式建模锚点-正样本-负样本三元组的多边际逆向最优传输耦合，克服了现有逆向OT方法因不利用负样本而导致的维度坍塌问题，提升了对比学习的下游性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Neg-MMIOT-CL, a multi-marginal inverse optimal transport contrastive learning approach that explicitly couples anchor-positive-negative triplets, overcoming the dimensional collapse caused by existing inverse OT methods' failure to utilize negative pairs and improving downstream performance.
